title: M1 · The shared Compare dialog and possible-duplicate box
intro: One design, built once, for Color Belt, Star, Camps and Black Belt (rulebook v1.030), copied from the look the four share today. Each section keeps its own noun and words. Amber outline = what the shared part decides. Two details to OK: the visible “⚠ different” (3) and “Keeping…” while it works (4). Nothing changes on screen until each section switches. Every state at all four sizes: M1-compare-duplicate.png.

sections.head: Compare — detail (a) to OK: a difference says “⚠ different”
While it works — detail (b) to OK: “Keeping…”
The other states (PC; every size is on the full sheet)
If saving fails — the note is never hidden

footer: What changes for each section when it switches (later, in its own prompt): Color Belt, Star and Camps gain the visible “⚠ different” (today only screen readers hear it) · every section gains “Keeping…” and gray buttons while it works · the failure note moves into the dialog's bottom area (today it can hide under the pinned buttons on short screens) · Camps gains Hide private details · Star's count stops repeating on every line.
